p06-run.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, navy T-shirt, grey shorts) and Sofia (curly dark hair in a high bun, bright blue T-shirt, black leggings) run side by side toward the camera on a wide path in a green park with trees.
p06-run.note: Usable: Luis matches the reference and the lesson's ATM photo; two people running in a park reads at 180 px; both stay inside the centered 4:5 crop.

d05-luis-backpack.observed_description: Luis in his navy T-shirt walks through a bright airport hall seen from the side, a large grey backpack on his back, turning to smile at the camera; rows of empty seats behind and one small blurred yellow sign with nothing readable.
d05-luis-backpack.note: Usable: the whole backpack is visible in 3:2; the centered 4:5 crop cuts part of it, so its item stays out of four-picture cards.

d06-ana-train.observed_description: Ana in her sage-green overshirt and jeans steps from the platform up into the open door of a silver train, lifting her dark-blue suitcase with one hand, seen from the side.
d06-ana-train.note: Usable: getting on a train with a suitcase reads at 180 px; a tiny mark low on the train body is not readable at phone size; no taxi or bus.

k05-left-light.observed_description: Seen from behind, a man with short dark curly hair in a navy T-shirt points his left arm along the left side street of a crossroads; a traffic light on a pole with its red lamp lit stands on the left corner; plain grey buildings, no shops and no crosswalk stripes.
k05-left-light.note: Usable: left arm and the traffic light are both on the left; the light sits outside the centered 4:5 crop, so its items stay out of four-picture cards.

k06-right-crosswalk.observed_description: Seen from behind, a woman with long dark wavy hair in a sage-green overshirt points her right arm along the right side street, across which lies a wide white zebra crosswalk; plain grey buildings, no traffic light and no shops.
k06-right-crosswalk.note: Usable: right arm and the crosswalk are both on the right; kept out of four-picture cards because the crosswalk reaches the right edge.

w06-bridge.observed_description: A long old stone bridge with many tall arches crosses a dry grassy valley under a pale blue sky, seen from the side; there is no water anywhere.
w06-bridge.note: Usable: a bridge and nothing else; no river, so it cannot be chosen for This is a river.

z05-map.observed_description: At a hotel's wooden front desk a smiling young receptionist in a white shirt and dark vest holds out a large unfolded street map, with green parks and a blue river line and no writing, to Ana in her sage-green overshirt, who takes it with both hands.
z05-map.note: Usable: Here's your map reads at 180 px; no key anywhere; both people and the map stay inside the centered 4:5 crop.
